critical strike chance to party and raid members; while active, you generate 3 Focus every second.

Ranger only. Expected: a grouped ally gains 5% melee crit and the Ranger keeps both effects. A
fresh character's crit field reads 0 until a crit aura first recomputes it, so Night Stalker 300792 primes
